skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of public services and management of public service provision by an organization.
Understand and apply the human resource management process within an organization providing public services.
Understand operational management techniques within organizations providing public services.
Understand the principles of strategic management in public service provision.
Demonstrate good skills in designing processes for public service provision and measurement systems.
Propose measures to improve customer satisfaction with public services.
Demonstrate good skills in identifying and resolving problems.
Demonstrate good skills in critical thinking.
Demonstrate good skills in conflict resolution.
Have the ability to work independently and take responsibility for professional tasks.
Be able to proactively plan, coordinate, assess, and improve professional tasks.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics.
Have the ability to self-learn and adapt to changes.
